top_stories.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
top_stories.one_liner: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.
top_stories.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.
top_stories.ai_overview: GPT‑6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities - Our GPT‑6 family of models can design new protein shapes and the sequence of their chemical building blocks using only reasoning and code, without calling specialized biology models to generate those designs. - An internal research model matched or outperformed specialized models on many protein design tasks.
top_stories.ai_what_happened: Researchers could also guide designs by prompting the model on where a protein should attach and what shape it should take.
ai_key_details: - In lab tests with Onava, proteins based on GPT‑6.2’s designs showed evidence of binding, or attachment, across five targets.
Redesigned antibodies also retained binding.
For example, we asked GPT‑6.2 to predict where and how a small molecule would bind to a protein.

We ran computational tests of whether the GPT‑6 models series could design small proteins to bind given targets, build proteins around specified structural features, predict protein structures and molecular interactions, and rank how sequence changes affect properties such as stability and binding.
top_stories.ai_why_it_matters: As our model’s reasoning capabilities improve, we envision researchers guiding protein structure generation much as they guide image generation today, by describing the features they want.

top_stories.title: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity
top_stories.one_liner: Mass Spec Skills empowers scientists using Google Antigravity to interpret tandem mass spectra.
top_stories.summary: Mass Spec Skills empowers scientists using Google Antigravity to interpret tandem mass spectra.
top_stories.ai_overview: From spectrum to structure: Identifying molecules with Mass Spec Skills for Google Antigravity Built in collaboration with analytical chemists and using community-developed tools, Mass Spec Skills empowers scientists using Google Antigravity to interpret tandem mass spectra, lay out chemical evidence, and match frontier-level retrieval accuracy even with a lightweight model. Every sample of blood, soil or plant tissue contains a vast array of small molecules, such as nutrients, hormones, drugs and their breakdown products, pollutants, or bioactive compounds with therapeutic potential.
top_stories.ai_what_happened: A modern mass spectrometer can detect tens of thousands of these molecular signals in a single drop of sample extract, measuring the masses of charged molecules and, in tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS), the fragments they break into.
ai_key_details: These measurements, however, do not directly reveal the molecular structure.
Researchers cannot immediately tell which compound produced a signal and relate it to its biological role or downstream use cases.

Yet even after a decade of expanding reference libraries, spectral searches annotate on average only about 5% of measured spectra, and 10% for human samples; the rest has been called the "dark matter" of mass spectrometry.

Each stage of that workflow can also be run on its own for smaller everyday tasks, from cleaning up a noisy recording to annotating peaks or comparing candidate isomers: From raw spectrum to structure end-to-end To see how the chemical evidence fits together in practice, consider the negative-mode tandem mass spectrum from the end-to-end run in Figure 2 (precursor [M−H]− at m/z 395.1387; Figure 3).

The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached input tokens, a 95% discount) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.
Neon can synthesize across all of these inputs in a single 1 million-token context window and turns inputs into structured deliverables.

top_stories.one_liner: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers managed cluster extensions for observability and user management, bringing declarative, API- and console-driven configuration to the software running on Slurm cluster nodes.
top_stories.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers managed cluster extensions for observability and user management, bringing declarative, API- and console-driven configuration to the software running on Slurm cluster nodes.
top_stories.ai_overview: Artificial Intelligence Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm Keeping a shared Slurm cluster for foundation model development in sync entails keeping several separately maintained pieces of configuration matched to what’s running on the nodes. The cluster’s shape lives on multiple configuration files, its software in custom scripts, its network topology in files that must be edited as nodes change, and its users in a roster that an administrator must maintain and rerun.
top_stories.ai_what_happened: Over time these pieces drift away from what’s actually running, and nothing tells you when they do.
ai_key_details: We believe cluster configurations should be managed the way you manage the rest of your AWS infrastructure.
You declare what you want through an API or the console, AWS validates it before it’s applied, the cluster is kept in that state continuously, and you can see whether it’s working.
On Slurm 25.11 or later, partition-level topology supports tree or block topology per partition.
top_stories.ai_why_it_matters: In this post, we walk through the features we introduced in 2026 and explain why the software on running nodes needed a different mechanism.
top_stories.ai_technical_breakdown: During 2026, Amazon SageMaker HyperPod brought that approach to Slurm clusters, with API-driven Slurm configuration, AMI-based configuration, continuous provisioning, automatic topology management, and deep health checks.

ai_key_details: They want to describe the information they need in their own words and get dependable, auditable answers from complex documents.
Today, we are announcing the general availability of Amazon Textract Insights, a new generative AI feature of Amazon Textract available through a new API within Amazon Textract.
top_stories.ai_why_it_matters: This maximizes available compute resources and model availability, and is designed to deliver a consistent customer experience.
